description: Stale local cumulative recovered by a single retry against the server's authoritative state.

initial_state.comment: Client believes the channel is fresh (e.g. restarted from disk and lost local state); server has already charged 100 from prior requests that have not yet been claimed onchain.

steps.action: POST a paid request with a voucher signed against the stale local cumulative.
Reject the voucher (server.charged_cumulative_amount ≥ voucher.max_claimable_amount) and return the authoritative channel state.

Verify total_claimed against the onchain BatchSettlement.channels(channel_id) call. Replace local cumulative with charged_cumulative_amount (100). Sign a new voucher with max_claimable_amount = charged_cumulative_amount + request_charge = 110. Retry exactly once.
Accept the retried voucher. Advance server charged_cumulative_amount to 110.

expected_client_behaviour.after_step_2: Detect corrective 402, parse channelState, verify total_claimed against onchain BatchSettlement.channels(channel_id), replace local cumulative with charged_cumulative_amount, sign new voucher, retry exactly once. Emit telemetry label recovery.stale_state.
expected_client_behaviour.after_step_4: Accept response. Effective charge for this request = request_charge = 10. Update local cumulative to 110.

invariants: The client must verify total_claimed against the onchain channel state before trusting charged_cumulative_amount; the server's value is only used to advance the local cumulative ceiling, never to confirm onchain truth.
Retry happens at most once. A second corrective 402 must escalate to a hard error (see loop-guard.json).
